decision.summary: A sharp multi-axis offset begins at index 588: N and E jump upward (~7.6 and ~7.2 MAD), U drops sharply (~-18.1 MAD); the offset persists through 594 with no return observed in any axis. From 595 onward, U partially recovers but N/E remain elevated and no full opposing return is observed within allowed context [545,630]. The candidate jump at index 590 aligns with the observed abrupt change. A second interval (595–630) is uncertain due to incomplete return evidence.

intervals.observation: N and E rise sharply from ~588–590 (N: ~0.5→8.1, E: ~2.2→9.4), U drops sharply (~-0.5→-18.6) over same 2–3 samples; sustained plateau through 594 with no return observed in N/E/U within allowed context.

U shows partial recovery from -18.6 to ~-16.3 between 595–630, but N/E remain elevated without clear opposing return; onset at 588 not fully resolved for U before drop, and return is incomplete/ambiguous beyond 630 (outside allowed context).
